_comment: Hard ceilings in BYTES for shipped artifacts, checked by scripts/check-size.mjs (warn locally, --strict in CI). Baselines and the ratchet discipline live in docs/perf-budget.md 'Size budget'. Ratchet DOWN as levers land; every INCREASE must be a deliberate, reviewed diff of this file. bootJsBytes = the entry chunk PLUS every chunk dist/index.html modulepreloads (the full static boot path; ratcheted 2026-08-17 to 1,040,000 after the A0 boot reclamation took the last six unclaimed surfaces lazy (BrowserPane, MemoryInspector, BookshelfView, OnboardingTour, SessionSidebar, FileViewer) with a boot-time landing-surface prefetch covering the doors — measured 1,010,988 B, ~29 KB headroom. Raised 2026-08-31 to 1,052,000 for the Front Door's harness picker: the HEAD baseline measured 1,038,732 B, i.e. 1.2 KB under the old ceiling, so the ratchet had already closed and any feature would have broken it. Measured after: 1,047,586 B, ~4 KB headroom. This was briefly 1,062,000 while the Codex plan contract was a TS module on the boot path; it moved to src-tauri/src/codex_plan_contract.txt (read by include_str! and written into the user's Codex config profile) when the inline-contract launch command turned out to exceed the 1024-byte tty input queue, which took 6.4 KB back off the entry chunk. Was 1,175,000 after MemorySurface went lazy 2026-08-14 — that lever paid for the Drafter's launch island, its blank page and the shared overlay mechanism, and the measured total AFTER all of it is 1,147,796 B, so ~27 KB of headroom remains. Was 1,210,000 with the path sitting at 99.1%). distTotalBytes ratcheted 2026-08-06 after the viewer folded into the main build (actual 7.71 MB, dist-viewer retired). mcpBinBytes RETIRED 2026-09-07: the redline-mcp proxy is gone, the daemon serves MCP at /mcp from polis-mcp (Polis E1). binaryBytes ratcheted 2026-08-06 after the first post-profile release build (strip/thin-LTO/1cgu + the slimmer embedded dist: actual 25.66 MB, was 30.04 MB pre-profile). RATCHETED 2026-09-02 to 660,000 by the boot-path work: the feature-island split (CommentCard/ReviewPanel/ReviewDiscussionPane/ReadmeModal/FeedbackModal/HowItWorks/Invite/Join/HookSetupModal lazy in App, AgentSeats+ExtensionsPanel lazy in Header, TerminalTabs mounted after the first actionable frame) took the whole markdown-rendering stack off the boot path — the chain was App → CommentCard → CommentThread → MarkdownView → markdown-it + highlight.js/lib/common + entities + linkify-it, ~670 KB of source nothing on a cold front door needed. Measured before 1,047,586 B (99.4% of the old 1,052,000 ceiling), after 550,553 B: −47.4%. The new ceiling leaves 16.6% headroom, over the 15% the boot program set as its floor. Source-level guards for every one of those boundaries live in src/lib/sizeGuard.test.ts and src/lib/boot.test.ts — including the terminal dock, whose old invariant asserted the OPPOSITE (‘stays static — it is first paint’) and is now inverted with its reason. RAISED 2026-09-08 to 36,000,000 (from 28,000,000): the release binary had been over the old ceiling since before the Polis extraction (main @ ba3b8cf measured 30.54 MB locally, 30.39 MB on CI, so the nightly size job was already red) and the program added measured, named weight — 31.10 MB after the extraction itself, 33.82 MB when the daemon started serving MCP in-process (rmcp + its schema generator; the separate 1.5 MB proxy binary went away), 34.05 MB with the run journal and undo, 34.39 MB with the Ed25519 identity crates. The new ceiling is the measured 34,385,264 B plus ~4.5 % headroom, so the guard fails again on the next unexplained megabyte instead of never passing. The levers, for a size session: MCP mounted only when enabled or without schema generation (~2.7 MB), the second sha2 line beside the app's, and an audit of main's own pre-program overage. RAISED 2026-09-09 to 36,050,000 after independent release-budget review for the history migration/error-handling repair and chat history diagnostics/progress: the pre-repair four-plan artifact measured 35,987,600 B and the repaired artifact 36,004,416 B (whole-artifact delta +16,816 B). This bounded 50,000 B ceiling increase (+0.139%) leaves 45,584 B headroom; frontend ceilings are unchanged. Details and validation: docs/history-and-chat-repair-2026-09-09.md.
